lines.speaker: Sergeant Wickramasinghe
lines.text: Two weeks. The campaign volume goes up. The legal boundaries do not move to accommodate it.

lines.speaker: Sergeant Wickramasinghe
lines.text: You read the manifesto? The infrastructure section — the road. The budget allocation for provincial road work is published by the Ministry. The numbers in that manifesto and the actual published allocation are worth comparing.

lines.speaker: Sergeant Wickramasinghe
lines.text: That manifesto of his. You read it? I have a copy of the 2010 one somewhere in my files. I was going to compare them once. Never got around to it. Probably not worth the time.
He said this while walking away. You cannot ask a follow-up question.
